title: Grant probes in the P13 kill test (and the P12/P13 live-state lines) could never match: wrong grantee quoting
what_went_wrong: p13_kill_test.sh l.46 queries information_schema.schema_privileges with grantee='"benchmark"@"localhost"'; the column stores 'benchmark'@'localhost' (single quotes), so the probe always returns nothing.

The P13 kill test's 'grant on sik_p13w: (none)' and the handoff's 'No benchmark grants on sik/sik_bench' rest on a probe that could not see a grant; the app account in fact holds DML on sik and broad privileges on sik_bench (P14 probe with LIKE '%benchmark%').
root_cause: No positive control for the probe (it was never shown to report a grant that exists).
detection: P15 verification of Astra v11 finding D4 (2026-10-26).
impact: The P13 kill-test 'no grant left' claim is unproven (P14's kill test used a working probe and showed 0 clone grants). The handoff statement is stale.

correction.applied: Recorded; P15 A7 replaces every grant probe with a correctly quoted one and requires a positive case; D4 corrects the handoff.

rule: Every absence probe needs a positive control showing it can detect presence.
